notes:
Account background:
- LoomLeaf is a direct-to-consumer and marketplace aggregator; large seasonal variance (Black Friday/Cyber ~6-8x baseline). Catalog ~12M SKUs including variants, ~350k active per region.
- Currently using ES + homegrown rerank rules; evaluating replace/augment with embedding-based candidate generation + neural reranker.

Recent timeline (shorthand):
- 2025-11-12: Intro kickoff (ff-20251112-kickoff) — high-level requirements, shared sample catalog.
- 2026-01-18: Discovery call — product taxonomy gaps identified, current ES latency p95 ~220ms under steady load.
- 2026-02-03: Demo w/ Redwood hosted embeddings pipeline; discussed top-k flow + reranker cost. (ff-20260203-loomleaf-demo)
- 2026-02-20: Security questionnaire submitted; waiting IdP config details. (drive:loomleaf/Security-Questionnaire-Responses)
- 2026-03-10: Cost-model review w/ engineering; agreed target CPA for search < $0.003/query at baseline traffic.

Use-case / requirements (explicit):
- Primary: product discoverability across web + mobile; exact-match fallback but want semantic recall for long-tail and synonyms.
- Candidate gen: embeddings-based ANN over product vectors; target recall@100 >= 0.92 for queries in benchmark set.
- Reranking: neural cross-encoder on top-50 candidates; wants configurable heuristics to boost in-stock + margin.
- Index scale: 12M SKU vectors (dense), 2.5B tokens across product descriptions. Need sharding/compaction guidance.
- Latency/throughput SLOs: p95 end-to-end (candidate+rerank) <= 200ms for search queries at baseline 500 qps; burst capacity to 5k qps for 90m flash windows.
- Cost sensitivity: target cost/query (all stages) < $0.003 at baseline; acceptable up to $0.01 during peak if SLA held. Strong interest in Redwood Optimize recommendations for batching/quantization to meet cost target.
- Routing/fallback: must auto-fallback to ES lexical pipeline on model OOM or regional outage. Prefer policy-based routing (latency first for mobile routes).
- Deployment: prefer VPC-enabled dedicated for production, hosted API for POC. Some EU markets require data residency and regional endpoints.
- Security: must pass SSO/SAML integration, SOC2 type II, audit logs for search requests tied to session ids, KMS integration for key rotation.

Technical notes / suggestions logged in calls:
- We suggested two-stage pipeline: dense ANN (64-d quantized vectors) -> light filter -> cross-encoder only on top-50. Cost estimate provided in pricing deck (drive:loomleaf/OO-Search-POC-Pricing-v2).
- Cache strategy: prefix+query hotlist to reduce reranker hits; pre-warm important seasonal queries before flash.
- Model preferences: open to Llama-2 derived embedding model + smaller cross-encoder for rerank (quantized bfloat16). Wants Redwood recommendations for model/quantization.
- Observability: needs per-query token cost breakdown and per-route dashboards for peak analysis.

Customer quotes / signals:
- "If we can keep cost/query under $0.003 without losing CTR, we can justify switching" — Head of Search (quote from 2026-03-10 call).
- Emphasis on predictable performance during seasonal spikes.

Next steps (short):
- Agree POC success criteria (precision/latency/cost) — AE/SE owners to draft by 2026-03-15.
- Provision hosted POC endpoint + sample index (Redwood) — target start 2026-03-18.
- Run 48h synthetic flash-sale run to validate burst handling and fallback.
- Security call to complete SSO questions, IdP test scheduled once internal IdP team clears time.

Open blockers: legal data residency clause (EU subset), one-month infra budget approval for POC, incomplete attribute coverage on sample catalog (variants/prices).
